description: This PHP class defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationService, a service layer component responsible for managing reporting methods within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for CRUD operations, querying, and validation related to reporting methods, interacting with a DAO layer and utilizing traits for normalization.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationService
classes.description: A service class in OrangeHRM for handling reporting method configurations, including CRUD operations, validation, and data normalization.

methods.name: getReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the ReportingMethodConfigurationDao instance.

methods.name: setReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Setter method for injecting a custom ReportingMethodConfigurationDao dependency.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Saves a ReportingMethod entity using the DAO layer.

methods.name: getReportingMethodById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod by its unique ID.

methods.name: getReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod by its name.

methods.name: getReportingMethodList
methods.description: Returns a list of reporting methods based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Returns the count of reporting methods matching certain filters.

methods.name: deleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Deletes multiple reporting methods identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if a reporting method name already exists.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns IDs of reporting methods that are currently in use.

methods.name: getReportingMethodArray
methods.description: Fetches and normalizes reporting method data into an array format suitable for external use.
